# scalar team

List and switch between your Scalar teams.

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`scalar team list`](#list) | List your Scalar teams |
| [`scalar team get`](#get) | Show the current team and its namespaces |
| [`scalar team set`](#set) | Select the current team |

## list

List your Scalar teams.

```bash
scalar team list [options]
```

**Options**

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--json` | Output teams as JSON. |
| `--no-input` | Disable prompts and browser launches. |

## get

Show the current team and its namespaces.

```bash
scalar team get [options]
```

**Options**

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--json` | Output the current team as JSON. |
| `--no-input` | Disable prompts and browser launches. |

## set

Select the current team.

```bash
scalar team set [options]
```

**Options**

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--json` | Output the result as JSON without prompting. |
| `--team <team>` | Team ID. |
| `--no-input` | Disable prompts and browser launches. |
